source.description:
PROBLEM: Fleet rows signal running+working twice and statically (leading ● plus trailing working word). Operator wants a visibly dynamic progress indicator.

SUCCESS: Running-and-working rows lead with a braille spinner frame (⠋⠙⠹⠸⠼⠴⠦⠧⠇⠏) selected pure-functionally from elapsed_s (frame = FRAMES[elapsed_s % len], so it advances on every repaint with no timers or state in the render path). Settled/waiting/needs-reply rows keep their existing markers (●/!/…). working/idle words stay (they carry meaning beyond motion). Operator eyeball-confirms motion without noise.

SCOPE: config/pi-extensions/specialist-subagents/index.mjs renderFleetRowLine only + unit tests (frame determinism, non-running rows untouched). No src/dist.

NON_GOALS: Collapsed line; colors; any other marker changes.

CONSTRAINTS: Render fns stay pure (no Date.now in frame choice -- elapsed_s is the tick);1472097184 no new dependencies.

VALIDATION: Extension suite green; operator eyeball on a live running row shows cycling frames.

OUTPUT: Spinner on working rows.

SCRUTINY: low
source.notes: typo fix: stray digits removed from CONSTRAINTS (render fns stay pure; no new dependencies).
source.title: Dynamic working indicator: tick-cycling spinner replaces static dot
